name: Maybank Family & Friends Card

Up to 8% Cashback on Malaysian Ringgit and Indonesia Rupiah spend
Up to S$180  Cashback Per Month
Earn up to 8% cashback globally on your 5 preferred cashback categories
Up to 8% cashback in local and overseas restaurant dining and online food delivery (e.g. Foodpanda and Deliveroo)
Up to 8% cashback on online purchases on Marketplace and other ecommerce platforms
Up to 8% cashback on petrol, EV charging and automotive related services

extra.summary: The Maybank Family and Friends Mastercard is designed to cater to the lifestyle and spending habits of families and friends, offering up to 8% cashback rewards on 5 categories such as dining & food delivery, online shopping, beauty & wellness, transport & petrol and online streaming.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.90% p.a. subject to a minimum charge of S$3.00
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 3% of outstanding balance or S$20, whichever is higher

our_takes.our-take: The Maybank Family & Friends Card shines for households targeting 8% cashback across daily essentials - groceries, transport, dining, and select online services, capped at $25 per category. Hitting the $800 monthly minimum spend is crucial to unlock these rates. A bonus: 8% on Malaysia/Indonesia spend, excluding existing categories. Consider this if you consolidate family expenses, but be mindful of the category caps. It’s less ideal for those with inconsistent spending or who prefer simpler, uncapped cashback cards. Activate categories post-card receipt for eligibility.
our_takes.good-for:
Families who spend on varied categories like groceries, dining, and retail, benefiting from the 8% cashback.
Individuals seeking rewards on daily transport, online streaming, and food delivery, maximizing returns on everyday expenses.
Those frequently travelling to Malaysia and Indonesia, enjoying 8% cashback on eligible Ringgit and Rupiah spending.
our_takes.things-to-note:
$800 minimum monthly spend is required; failing to meet it forfeits the 8% cashback.
Cashback is capped at $25 per category monthly, limiting potential rewards if you overspend.
A 27.9% p.a. interest rate applies if you carry a balance, costing you significantly.
